1339-2034-6254-7924.description:
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw two cards due to Vnwxt.
The Locust God triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4279-5687-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

323-4279-6248--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-6248--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2724-7309-8172.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 1.

3899-7430--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Resolve the persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

3446-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

4067-5168-7890.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {2}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.

1778-2626-3967-4986.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1090-1594-1739-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-5163-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Roon of the Hidden Realm.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-5088-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2292-5088-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, scrying 1.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, scrying 1.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

457-1458-4404-6632.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6632.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to The Water Crystal.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1824-2530-6710-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6710-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1879-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

339-677-1849-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-1849-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

813-3617-7174.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-3129-3899-5223.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

296-3375-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3375-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2366-4452-5413-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-5413-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5639-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two artifacts.
You have one or fewer cards in hand.
5639-6747-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1939-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-554-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-2292.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1414-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
874-1170-1414-6862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1414-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

500-1777-4863.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Revolutionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Revolutionist tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Revolutionist token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2279-2921-5058.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

224-1772-5478-5621.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

2351-3985-4639.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Opposition by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Opposition ability.
Repeat.

969-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
969-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-2103-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1309-1987-2103-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-5999.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1061-1576-4499.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-4499.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering Emiel the Blessed and its own first ability.
Resolve Forerunner of the Coalition's ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Decline to use Emiel the Blessed's triggered ability.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability and Emiel the Blessed.
Resolve Forerunner of the Coalition's ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Decline to use Emiel the Blessed's triggered ability.
Repeat.

152-1766-1912-2557.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo.
Activate the token Thran Dynamos by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.
